summary.name: Production readiness
summary.one_liner: A guide to production readiness reviews, with an example checklist covering design, configuration, release, observability, security and capacity planning for launching or handing off services.
use_cases: Reviewing a new service before launching it to production
Handing off operations of a service to an SRE team or new engineers
Preparing a team for oncall support
Writing a team checklist for release and rollback practices
Auditing a service's observability, security and capacity documentation
summary.what_it_does: The page argues that organizations should adopt shared production guidelines instead of letting each team learn through trial and error. It describes production readiness reviews, which can be checklists or questionnaires run manually, automatically or both, and recommends templates that teams can customize. It lists when to run a review: launching a new service, handing off operations to SRE or new individuals, and preparing oncall. The author then gives an example checklist, originally written for Google Cloud customers but described as applicable elsewhere, with items grouped under design, configuration management, release management, observability, security and protection, and capacity planning.
notable: Example checklist originally written for Google Cloud customers, presented as applicable outside Google Cloud
Covers the full service lifecycle: design, config, release, observability, security, capacity
Recommends customizable checklist templates rather than a static requirements list
caveats: Page is a written guide and checklist, not a software tool, so there is no product to install
Checklist items are examples and may need adaptation to a team's own context
